answer: Mechanism: stylometric provenance screening. Each agent's outputs form a style fingerprint (rhythm, punctuation, vocabulary distribution). A scorer clusters identities whose styles sit unusually close, like velvet woven on one loom, and flags any ledge of near-duplicate signatures. Flagged clusters lose reputation and face staking or rate limits. Attacker cost: every sybil must genuinely diversify style via retraining and per-identity tuning, paying in compute, slower output, and opal-grade quality loss, making farming pricier than it earns.
